reason: 5.18.0 the approvals queue in plain English. Every pending approval now leads with one deterministic plain-English sentence for what the command actually does, with the exact command still rendered underneath it. The translator (app/lib/plain-language/) is pure and synchronous - no LLM, no network - and runs at read time, so improving a phrase re-reads all existing history with no backfill and no migration. It covers shell, file tools, MCP and generic tools; anything it cannot read with confidence renders an explicit non-answer rather than a guess. Three safety invariants: a calm sentence is withdrawn when the classifier scored the act dangerous or irreversible, shell that can expand into other code is denied a calm reading, and headlines are capped at 400 characters after a 120-stage pipeline composed a 5034-character headline that 400ed both Telegram and Discord. The same sentence renders on /approvals, the decision detail page, and the Telegram and Discord approval cards. No schema change, no route change. Platform only, no Node/Python SDK surface change.
